clue.text: Meet South African model returning before start of fashion year

indicators.note: returning says the word for model is read backwards

parts.note: to model is to sit for an artist

indicators.note: start of picks the opening letter of fashion

explanation.surface: A South African model flies home just ahead of the fashion year's opening.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet a need or requirement is to fulfil it, a synonym.

clue.text: True Conservative shape

definitions.meaning: a four-sided figure with equal sides and right angles

explanation.definitionFit: The word means accurately aligned, stuffily conventional, and a regular four-sided figure.

clue.text: Pinch article about one empty vehicle

indicators.note: about says the article goes around the next letter

parts.note: the is the definite article
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: empty means the inside of vehicle is removed, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: Stealing a thing from an empty car.
explanation.definitionFit: To pinch is informal for to steal, a synonym.

clue.text: Entranced by time before spring

parts.note: a spell is a period of time
to bound is to spring or leap

explanation.surface: Held captive by the months before spring.
explanation.definitionFit: Being held as if by magic means entranced, a synonym.

clue.text: Leaders of yesteryear approach captain helming tourist vessel

indicators.note: Leaders of picks the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: In the old days, a captain at the wheel of a tourist boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailing or motor boat for pleasure is a kind of vessel.

clue.text: Try getting place in athletic 23

parts.note: a shot is an attempt or try
to put something is to place it

explanation.surface: Having a go at finding a slot in an athletics meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 23 refers to the answer at 23 down, EVENT, so 'athletic 23' means a field event in athletics.
explanation.definitionFit: Throwing a heavy ball for distance is a standard field contest in track and field.

clue.text: Curtains put up across mantle regularly pulled apart

indicators.note: across means the reversed curtains stretch over the other letters
put up in a down clue means the word for curtains reads upwards, backwards

parts.note: drapes are curtains

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of mantle

explanation.surface: Curtains hung over a mantelpiece, pulled apart now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' signals reading upwards because this is a down clue; 'across' has the reversed SEPARD straddle the alternate letters, ATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Things pulled apart have been divided or parted, a synonym.

clue.text: Notice of death from mosquito bite

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the words mosquito bite

explanation.surface: A death caused by a mosquito, as reported in the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for obituary, a newspaper notice of someone's death.

clue.text: Non-physical complaint head of medicine dismissed wrongly

indicators.note: wrongly says the remaining letters are put in the wrong order
dismissed says a letter is sent out of complaint
head of picks the first letter of medicine

explanation.surface: A doctor brushes aside an illness as not being bodily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head of medicine dismissed' takes M out of COMPLAINT, and 'wrongly' rearranges COPLAINT.
explanation.definitionFit: Love that is affectionate but not sexual is non-physical, a synonym.

clue.text: Old record those people keep for study of religion

indicators.note: keep says the word for those people holds the other letters inside

parts.note: they means those people
a log is a written record

explanation.surface: People holding on to an old record for religious study.
explanation.definitionFit: The academic discipline concerning God and religious belief.

clue.text: Join university side, leaving in the morning

parts.note: uni is the informal short form of university

indicators.note: leaving says the morning letters depart from the word for side

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
AM is the abbreviation for morning, ante meridiem

explanation.surface: Someone joins a university team but heads off early in the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' takes AM out of TEAM, leaving TE.
explanation.definitionFit: To join things together is to bring them into one, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Charm hostage over a time

indicators.note: over means the word for hostage covers and encloses the other letters

parts.note: a hostage is a captive

explanation.surface: A kidnapper woos a hostage for a while.
explanation.definitionFit: To charm someone is to enchant or delight them, a synonym.

clue.text: Party has a politician that's informative

parts.note: a revel is a lively party
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A party with a politician present turns out to be enlightening.
explanation.definitionFit: Something revealing new facts is informative, a near synonym.

clue.text: Heat black fossil fuel

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
oil is a fossil fuel

explanation.surface: Warming up some dark crude.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring liquid to bubbling temperature is to heat it strongly.

clue.text: Tender name broadcast as expression of love

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered about, so the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A soft name spoken on air as a sign of love.
explanation.definitionFit: A pet name or affectionate word is an expression of fondness.

clue.text: Remaining excellent

definitions.meaning: still unpaid or unresolved, as a debt left over

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both still owed or unresolved and exceptionally good.

clue.text: Hooligans drop onto a path leading south

parts.note: a tear is a drop from the eye
a way is a path

explanation.surface: Thugs fall onto a path heading south.
explanation.definitionFit: Reckless, unruly young people are hooligans, a near synonym.

clue.text: Crazy mount rearing following quiet procedure

indicators.note: following says the reversed letters come after the quiet letter

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: rearing in a down clue means the words read upwards, backwards

parts.note: loco is slang for crazy
a tor is a rocky hill or mount

explanation.surface: A wild horse rears up behind a quiet rule of etiquette.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rearing' turns LOCOTOR into ROTOCOL, placed after P.
explanation.definitionFit: Protocol is the accepted procedure or code of conduct.

clue.text: Love calling for exclusion

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
a mission is a vocation or calling

explanation.surface: A love that calls for leaving someone out.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaving something out is exclusion, a synonym.

clue.text: Firework in love story about foreign land

indicators.note: about says the love story wraps around the other letters

parts.note: a romance is a love story

indicators.note: foreign suggests the letters of land become strange, rearranged

explanation.surface: A romantic tale set abroad with fireworks in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'love story' looks like part of the definition, but the firework alone is defined; 'foreign' scrambles the land, giving ANDL.
explanation.definitionFit: This tube-shaped device shooting coloured balls of fire is a type of firework.

clue.text: Den raised after a bit of excitement in the air

indicators.note: after says the reversed den comes behind the first letters
bit of picks the first letter of excitement
raised in a down clue means the word for den reads upwards, backwards

parts.note: a lair is a den

explanation.surface: A den lifted up after a moment of thrills, now airborne.
explanation.definitionFit: Aerial means existing or happening in the air, a synonym.

clue.text: Fool rejects shuffling with no clubs

indicators.note: shuffling says the remaining letters are mixed up
with no says the clubs letter is removed

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs in cards

explanation.surface: A fool turns down a card game shuffle without any clubs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no clubs' removes C from REJECTS, and 'shuffling' rearranges REJETS.
explanation.definitionFit: A court jester was the professional fool who entertained a monarch.

clue.text: Works a treat, reversing to include charge

indicators.note: reversing says the hidden letters are read backwards
to include says the letters sit within the clue words Works a treat

explanation.surface: Something works wonders once turned round to take in a fee.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'include charge' as the definition; 'to include' is the hidden-word indicator and the definition is 'charge' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A charge is a duty or job entrusted to someone, a synonym.

clue.text: No pay rise, as few agree arrangement before final letter to Europe

indicators.note: arrangement says the letters of few agree are set in a new order

parts.note: Z is the final letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: Few agree to the deal that freezes salaries before it goes to Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: A government or employer halting salary increases imposes this kind of pay policy.

clue.text: English opening race perhaps

parts.note: a vent is an opening

explanation.surface: The English start a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A race is an example of a sporting contest, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Clean with volcanic dust

parts.note: ash is the dust thrown out by a volcano

explanation.surface: Scrubbing something with volcanic grit.
explanation.definitionFit: To clean something with water and soap is a synonym.

clue.text: Feature sensible dinner service

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature
sensible in the old sense of conscious of, aware

explanation.surface: A distinctive and practical set of plates.
explanation.definitionFit: Porcelain plates and dishes form a dinner service, a near synonym.

clue.text: Old first to be present

parts.note: ex means former or old, as in ex-husband
1st written out as IST, the numeral 1 read as I

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned call to be first in attendance.
explanation.walkthrough: First is written 1st, and the numeral 1 is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: To be present in the world is to have being, a synonym.

clue.text: Left top off groups of bananas as meals

indicators.note: top off says the first letter is removed from the word for groups of bananas

parts.note: bananas grow in bunches

explanation.surface: Leftover bananas with the tops cut off make up the meals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top off' removes B from BUNCHES, leaving UNCHES.
explanation.definitionFit: Midday meals are the plural of the light noon repast.

clue.text: Nominal time in strange ritual

indicators.note: in says the time letter goes inside the shuffled letters
strange says the letters of ritual are jumbled

explanation.surface: A time slot in an odd ceremony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strange' rearranges RITUAL to ITULAR, and T goes in at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A titular head holds the title in name only, so nominal is a synonym.
